body.x: AI servers run cool most of the time and then spike hot under heavy load, and cooling sized for the peak wastes power the rest of the day. Switching modes with the load, like a hybrid car, matches the effort to the moment.
Naintech Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Enterprise Tech and Energy Transition & Sustainability at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for the HTRC, a hybrid thermoelectric rack cooler.

HTRC (Hybrid Thermoelectric Rack Cooler) is a rack-integrated cooling system for AI servers that combines air, liquid and thermoelectric (TEC) cooling in one unit. It works like a hybrid vehicle: under normal load, a 3-way valve forms a closed loop and the radiator handles heat by air cooling alone; when server load exceeds a threshold, the valve switches to the TEC loop, circulating coolant chilled by thermoelectric modules to the servers. This active, current-controlled regulation keeps GPUs in their optimal temperature range and concentrates cooling on hotspots, and a built-in control IC predicts GPU load in real time to select between energy-saving and boost modes automatically.
Because the entire system fits inside the rack, no external chillers, CRAC units or piping are required, reducing footprint while targeting a PUE of 1.1 to 1.2.
The modular design scales from a single Edge node to multi-rack data centers.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
